subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, select the figure that can be placed at the sign of the question mark (?) from among the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd188a13c1e2924888d9b2176e7160b1bf770ef65b87d0202c0637b2f03a22f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** The letters move in a **fixed anti-clockwise rotation across the corners**, along with a **center-corner shifting pattern**.

So far, the corner letters rotate **anti-clockwise**:

Top-Left → Bottom-Left → Bottom-Right → Top-Right → Top-Left.

At the same time, the **center letter shifts to the Bottom-Right corner**, and the **Top-Left letter moves to the center** in the next step.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a013180e01eddb15404fc6de93c0f6a8da6a212eafa44783ffe82fab5ae402d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
